Tess K.: quick Q — I'm flying to SF for a 2‑day customer offsite next week. Can I expense a pet‑sitter / dog boarding for the trip? Estimated cost ~$120.
Linda (People Ops): short answer: usually no. pet care is considered personal and isn't reimbursable by default. :dog:
Tess K.: ok — understood. any way to get it covered in special cases?
Linda (People Ops): we can make exceptions but only with preapproval. exceptions are limited to: 1) documented medical accommodation (health or disability) or 2) a verified business justification where lack of care would prevent you from attending a customer‑facing event. in either case you need manager approval + people‑ops preapproval before booking.
Omar (manager): @Tess K. if you think this would block you from attending, ping me and i'll approve the preapproval request.
Tess K.: thanks — i'll request it. what's the process?
Linda (People Ops): please do this: 1) email people‑ops@redwood.com with subject "Pet care preapproval — [Your name] [dates]" 2) attach trip confirmation (flight or hotel) and a quote/invoice from the sitter showing dates and rates 3) include manager approval (screenshot of DM or cc your manager on the email). we'll review within 48 business hours. do not book expecting reimbursement until preapproval is granted.
Tess K.: got it. and if it's approved, what receipts do i need at expense submission?
Linda (People Ops): submit the itemized invoice from the sitter (must show dates and name of pet/owner or booking reference), proof of travel (boarding pass or hotel folio), manager approval note, and the people‑ops preapproval email. expense category to use: "Other — Pet Care (preapproved)".
FinanceBot: note: finance requires full receipts for any cash transactions; if paying cash to a sitter please get a signed receipt with amount, dates, and sitter contact.
Tess K.: is there any cap on amount if preapproved?
Linda (People Ops): no hard dollar cap but reviewers will evaluate reasonableness against comparable local boarding rates. if cost looks outsized we may ask for alternatives (in‑home sitter quote, family support, etc.).
Omar (manager): i'd be fine approving this one — looks reasonable. cc @Linda (People Ops).
Tess K.: filing the preapproval now, thanks y'all :heart:
Linda (People Ops): thanks — once approved you'll get a confirmation email you must attach to the expense. if denied we'll explain why and options.
Tess K.: noted, appreciate the quick help.
